text: ちょっと　いきぬきの　つもりが　むちゅうに　なっちまう！

structure.jp: ちょっと　いきぬきの　つもりが
structure.en: I meant it as just a little breather, but

structure.jp: むちゅうに　なっちまう！

patterns.name: 〜つもりが
patterns.span: いきぬきの　つもりが
patterns.explanation: つもり is what you intended, and が after it says things turned out differently. いきぬきの　つもりが = 'I only meant to take a breather, but'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough, masculine short form of てしまう, which says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. なっちまう = 'I end up becoming'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: むちゅうに　なっちまう
patterns.explanation: に plus なる says what state someone gets into. むちゅうに　なっちまう = 'I end up getting hooked'.
